page0.text:
...I'll rest a bit before we resume our strategy meeting.
What is it about cats, kotatsu, and mandarins?
It's been snowing outside, so I guess there isn't anything wrong with relaxing in the living room.
Not that there's a kotatsu—a heated table—in the living room right now.

page1.text:
"Oh? You're going to eat mandarins, Shirou?"
"I am. There's still a lot left, so we need to finish them up before they rot.
There being three boxes was unexpected. But since you went through the trouble of buying them, it'd be a waste not to eat them all."
I sit down and pour some tea.

page2.text:
"Hehe. Okay, then I'll give you three."
"That's stupid, I just ate. I can't finish that many."
I take two mandarins from her hand and start peeling the skin off.

page3.text:
Tohsaka went off to who knows where, but she should be back soon.
For now, I just want to relax until I finish eating the mandarins.

page4.text:
"Hey, Shirou. It seems like Saber went to the dojo. You don't need to bring this tea to her?"
"Hm, I guess I should. Hold on, I'll go bring her some after I finish eating one."

page5.text:
"No, I can take them to Saber. You just stay and relax.
Though, don't you have to keep Tohsaka company? After going through all that trouble to invite her, she'll hate you if you left her alone."

page6.text:
"Oof, guh...!"
I swallow the mandarin that I popped in my mouth without chewing.
H-how did she arrive at that conclusion!?

page7.text: "T-that's a misunderstanding, idiot...! I-I didn't invite her today, and I don't care whether Tohsaka likes me or not...!"

page8.text:
"Oh, really? You seemed like you were conscious about Tohsaka the whole time."
"Your eyes were just playing tricks on you!!! First of all, I don't know if she's in the restroom or what, but we're going to finish our work once she gets back, and I'm going to send her home right away!"

page9.text:
"Oh, I see. So it was just my misunderstanding.
Then I'm going to bring some mandarins and tea to Saber."

page10.text:
Fuji-nee puts them on a tray and leaves the living room.
Yeah, go away. Leave me in peace.

page11.text:
I eat my mandarins in silence after Fuji-nee leaves.
Tohsaka isn't back and I have nothing else to do, so I keep on eating.
As I finish the last mandarin and lay down...

page12.text:
"But Shirou, you like Tohsaka more than Saber, right?"
"Yeah."
I let my guard down and reply automatically.

page13.text:
"F-F-Fuji-nee...!"
"See, I knew it. You're full of openings!"
Fuji-nee runs away in a flash, like an escaping rabbit.
I don't even try running after her.

page14.text:
"Ugh... Well I've known Tohsaka for a longer time, she's pushy, a real red something, and..."
I repeat excuses that I don't even get myself with a flushed face.
